scope: Fast project storage management, bulk delete, background purge, cumulative virtual-registration and permanent-point-deletion regression.

storage_quarantine_benchmark.fixture: 80 sparse cache files at 2 GiB logical size each
storage_quarantine_benchmark.note: Synthetic same-volume Linux metadata-rename benchmark only. It validates that delete returns after quarantine instead of waiting for physical erase; it is not a Windows/Defender timing promise.

broader_registration_note: Known-diameter sphere, large-coordinate registration, spatial-index fitting and project save/portable tests pass when optional exchange-format dependencies are not required. The Linux host lacks pye57, laspy and plyfile for existing E57/LAS/LAZ/PLY round-trip tests.
windows_limit: Native Windows/WebView2/NTFS junction and antivirus behavior cannot be exercised on the Linux build host.
